observations.summary: President Zelenskiy stated Ukraine conducted a multi-stage drone and missile operation against the Kerch Bridge. Footage he published appears to show the main road arch collapsed and navigation obstructed, but Reuters explicitly could not independently verify the footage. Earlier Russian reports acknowledged traffic suspension but not the extent of damage. Treat structural collapse as unverified until independent imagery or operator confirmation.
observations.title: Ukraine claims severe Kerch Bridge damage after multi-stage strike
